thread:
omar: Hey all, first day. I installed Cloudflare WARP (personal) for some dev testing earlier and left it on. Company WireGuard split-tunnel is active but internal services (api.internal.redwood, registry.internal.redwood) resolve to Cloudflare IPs and TLS shows public certs. docker pulls and internal curl fail. Anyone run into WARP + WG conflicts?

infra-jen: welcome! Yup, WARP can hijack DNS and create a virtual adapter that takes precedence. Quick tests: `ip addr` to see interfaces, `ip route` to inspect route order, and `systemd-resolve --status` or `scutil --dns` (mac). Also run `dig +short registry.internal.redwood @10.10.0.2` (company DNS) vs `dig +short registry.internal.redwood` to see which resolver returns Cloudflare IP.

omar: dig to company DNS returns 10.10.6.5, default dig returns 104.21.45.6 (CF). ip route shows wg0 exists but a CF virtual adapter has lower metric.

security-ops: for short-term unblock: 1) disable WARP (turn off the app) and reconnect WireGuard; or 2) set the FQDN with trailing dot for curl to bypass search/suffix tricks: `curl https://registry.internal.redwood./v2/` 3) add temporary /etc/hosts entries pointing internal hosts to the 10.10.x.x addresses. Long-term we should avoid shipping onboarding images with WARP enabled.

claire: additional trick if you can't fully disable WARP: change route metric so wg0 wins for internal CIDR. Example (Linux): `sudo ip route replace 10.10.0.0/16 dev wg0 proto static metric 50` and set the CF adapter metric higher. On macOS you can reorder service order in Network Preferences or `sudo route change`. But easiest is uninstall/disable WARP for onboarding devices.

omar: disabled WARP and reconnected WG; dig now returns 10.10.6.5 and docker pull works. Will uninstall WARP.

infra-jen: creating INF-1512: "personal VPN (Cloudflare WARP) causes DNS/route precedence issues for new-hires" assigned to eng-infra. We'll add a note to the onboarding checklist: check for other VPNs (WARP/Proton) and ensure they are disabled before using company WireGuard.

ops-bot: INF-1512 created: priority P3, assignee eng-infra.

omar: thanks everyone! will document the WARP uninstall step in my onboarding notes. :thumbsup:
